I need to know the hostname/domain of your internal git remote. Based on the `.env` file, I see the API domain is `api.acme-internal.net`. 

Could you provide:
1. The git remote URL (or hostname) for the internal remote you're pushing to? For example: `git@git.acme-internal.net:org/repo.git`
2. What you'd like to call the remote in your git config (e.g., `origin`, `internal`, etc.)?

Alternatively, if you can tell me the hostname and I can infer the rest, here's a template SSH config entry that would work:

```
Host git.acme-internal.net
    HostName git.acme-internal.net
    User git
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
    IdentitiesOnly yes
    AddKeysToAgent yes
```

This goes in `~/.ssh/config`. Replace `git.acme-internal.net` with your actual git server hostname. Then you can do `git remote add origin git@git.acme-internal.net:org/repo.git` and pushing will use this SSH config automatically.
